meta.title: Hearth — a calmer way to find a housemate
meta.description: Hearth helps students and first-time movers find someone they enjoy living with, with plain-language matches and privacy by default.

common.errorBody: We could not load this page. Please try again.

auth.title: Sign in to Hearth
auth.body: We will email you a six-digit code. No password needed.
auth.codeBody: We sent a six-digit code to {{email}}.
auth.passkeyBody: Use your device's fingerprint, face or PIN.
auth.trustBody: One code by email, no passwords, no spam. We never share your email or post anything for you.
auth.terms: By continuing you agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.sendFailed: We could not send the code. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not correct or has expired.
errors.passkeyFailed: The passkey sign-in did not finish. Try the email code instead.

onboarding.title: Let's set up your profile
onboarding.photoRequired: Add a profile photo to continue.
onboarding.saveFailed: We could not save this step. Please try again.
onboarding.incomplete: A few details are still missing. Check your answers.

about.title: What should we call you?
about.body: Your name and a photo help people recognise you.

location.title: Where are you looking?
location.body: We show an approximate area only, never an exact address.

timing.title: When, and at what budget?
timing.body: Tell us your move-in window and the range that works for you.

living.title: How do you want to live?
living.body: A few words about you and what you are looking for.

finish.title: All set?
finish.body: Review your choices and pick the app language.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: Keep your details current. You decide what is visible.
profile.incompleteBanner: Your profile is not complete yet.
profile.saveFailed: We could not save your changes.

photo.label: Profile photo
photo.hint: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB. Location data is removed automatically.
photo.invalidType: Use a JPEG or PNG image.
photo.tooLarge: The image must be 5 MB or smaller.
photo.uploadFailed: We could not upload the photo.
photo.removeFailed: We could not remove the photo.

areaLabel.label: Area
areaLabel.hint: For example Koukaki, Athens. No exact address.

campus.label: University
campus.hint: Optional. It helps us suggest nearby areas.
campus.loadFailed: We could not load the university list.

lifeStage.label: Life stage
lifeStage.first-time-mover: Moving out for the first time

seeking.label: Looking for
seeking.hint: A room, a roommate, or both.

language.label: App language
language.hint: The language Hearth uses for you.

academic.title: Student email
academic.body: Verify your university email for a small badge. Optional.
academic.sendFailed: We could not send the code.
academic.rateLimited: Wait a moment before requesting another code.
academic.hourlyLimited: We can't send more codes this hour. Try again later.
academic.invalidCode: That code is not correct or has expired.
academic.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.body: Sign in without a code, using your fingerprint or face.
passkeys.unsupported: This device or browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.empty: You have not added a passkey yet.
passkeys.addFailed: We could not add the passkey.
passkeys.deleteFailed: We could not remove the passkey.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Download a copy of your data or delete your account.
data.exportFailed: We could not download your data.
data.deleteFailed: We could not delete your account.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: This permanently deletes your profile, photo, sessions and passkeys. It cannot be undone.

home.title: A calmer way to find a housemate.
home.body: We match you on how you live, explain every match in plain words, and never sell your data.

values.label: What matters here
values.compatibilityBody: Rent, area and dates are filters. The real question is whether daily life fits.
values.clarityBody: No mystery score. You see the overlaps and the things worth talking about.
values.privacyBody: We collect the minimum, show approximate areas, and keep safety features free.

status.title: Service status
status.okDescription: The app and API are running.
status.error: We can't reach Hearth right now.

matches.title: Matches
matches.body: Your first matches will appear here after you finish the Vibe Cards. Until then, the space is yours.

messages.title: Messages
messages.body: When you and someone both agree to talk, your conversation will live here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: Tell Hearth how you live and what matters to you. You stay in control of what is visible.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Hearth will pick up where you left off. Check your connection and try again.

pwa.updateBody: Refresh when it suits you. Nothing will be lost.
pwa.offlineReady: Hearth is ready to work offline.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the page may have moved.
